intro: Stormy Potential is a quest in Durotar given by the goblin Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine. Hoping to protect his trade caravan against marauding harpies, Rezlak seeks to supercharge a depleted orb using the potent electrical organs of native thunder lizards.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: "Rezlack, when an opportunity comes knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.
This orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!
There are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.
Go harvest some and bring them back to me!

clips.title: Progress
paras: It might come as a surprise that with a name like thunder lizard they shoot lightning instead of roaring like thunder.
Well, they do. Shoot lightning, I mean.
Trust me, it's a lesson you only get to learn once if you're lucky.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hey, thanks pal! You've been a really big help to me here and I appreciate it.
Here's to hoping I can get this all charged up using these organs. I bet it'll make those no good harpies think twice about attacking my caravan again. I sure hope this works.
Either way you've done your side of the deal. Take this for your trouble.
